name: Suburban Cook County - Selected Causes of Death
attribution: Cook County Department of Public Health

Detailed Descriptive.Data notes: When the number of deaths is between 1 and 4, the data is suppressed and notated with a '*' symbol. Crude and/or age-adjusted rates are suppressed when counts are below 20 and symbolized with a '-'. Be aware that these symbols do not download and are replaced with a blank.
Detailed Descriptive.Geographic coverage: Cook County without City of Chicago

columns.name: Section
columns.description: Underlying Cause of Death categorized into 7 main sections

columns.name: Sub-Section
columns.description: Underlying cause of death sections categorized into Sub-section

columns.name: Place
columns.description: Decedent's Town or SCC District or Residence (see SCC District Map)

columns.name: Crude Mortality Rate
columns.description: The mortality rate from all causes of death for a population during a specified time period, multiplied by 100,000

columns.name: Age Adjusted Mortality Rate
columns.description: Age-adjustment is a statistical process applied mortality rates which allows communities with different age structures to be compared. Adjustment is accomplished by first multiplying the age-specific rates of death by age-specific weights based off of the 2010 standard population. The weighted rates are then summed across the age groups.
